| Extra work | Date and state | Source |
|---|---|---|

Important interpretation:

- **Do not classify secure credential handling, TOTP, fresh-session reuse, recovery, revocation, or honest outcome verification as optional extras.** They were original requirements.
- Multiuser isolation and a Seatbelt sandbox were added engineering complexity, but once the multiuser/generated-code design was selected, their correctness became necessary, not cosmetic scope creep.
- Session reuse is core; the **personal/shared-account topology, migration and concurrency machinery** is the expanded architecture.
- Residential proxy and website compatibility work mostly support core browser reliability, so I would not prioritize them as pure extras.
- A demo is required. Avatar/branding polish could be extra, but I only found the lettermark asset here, not evidence for the avatar effort.
- Do not credit the vendored Hermes agent/browser/vault framework as newly authored Clanker work.

Completion-related evidence discovered:

- [docs/SUBMISSION.md:7](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/docs/SUBMISSION.md:7) still lists clean-machine setup, reviewer-first-task acceptance, demo, isolation/TOTP confirmation and publication review as pending.
- README has demo placeholders, but its **0/12** status is stale: [Oct 11 repair record:41](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/docs/decisions/2026-10-11-benchmark-reliability.md:41) records last completed full-suite **6/12 functional**, plus later repair runs. It is an expanded benchmark, so failing it is not automatically equivalent to failing the assignment.
- The useful phrasing is **“You had already gone beyond the assignment by Oct 5–6; that is not evidence the assignment was fully accepted on that date.”**
